newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen lower after jobless claims.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen lower after jobless claims.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to head lower at the opening after weekly jobless claims fell to a weaker than forecast 320,000 from a revised 342,000 the prior week and sparked selling in bonds.
But analysts said that Wednesday's late strength was encouraging and that the market could see some firmness today if high techs followed through on their bounce.
"The bond market and foreign markets are lower so I think the Dow will be hit a little at the opening," said Kenneth Ducey, director of trading at BT Brokerage.
The long bond was down 8/32 to yield 6.85 percent.
